//@version=6
// ============================================================
// Indicators_Plot_HIGH_MOMENT_SCREENER  —  auto-generated by FF_Finance

// Generated : 2026-08-06 21:16:49

// ============================================================

indicator("FF_Stocks Indicators — HIGH_MOMENT_SCREENER", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

// ─── Cup & Handle Inputs ────────────────────────────────────────
cup_color    = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Cup Color")
handle_color = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Handle Color")
pivot_color  = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Pivot Color")
target_color = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Target Color")
line_width   = input.int(3, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
show_labels  = input.bool(true, "Show Labels")
show_target  = input.bool(true, "Show Target Line")
label_size   = input.string("Normal", "Range Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"])
// ─── TrendLine Inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────
tl_support_color    = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "TrendLine: Support Color")
tl_resistance_color = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0),  "TrendLine: Resistance Color")
tl_line_width       = input.int(1, "TrendLine: Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
tl_show_labels      = input.bool(true, "TrendLine: Show Labels")
// ─── Tunnel Inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────
tn_color       = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "Tunnel: Color")
tn_line_width  = input.int(2, "Tunnel: Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
tn_show_labels = input.bool(true, "Tunnel: Show Labels")
// ─── Rise Curve Inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────
rc_color       = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Rise Curve: Color")
rc_line_width  = input.int(2, "Rise Curve: Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
rc_show_labels = input.bool(true, "Rise Curve: Show Labels")

// ─── TrendLines ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_draw_tl() =>

    var tl_tickers     = array.from("ECO", "ECO", "ECO", "FIHL", "GIC", "GIC", "LNC", "LNC", "SHOO", "SHOO", "AMP", "AMP", "BLFS", "ING", "JLL", "JLL", "JLL", "PRU", "PRU", "PRU", "RJF", "SEIC", "SEIC", "RTX", "RTX", "RTX", "WSBC")

    var tl_start_ts    = array.from(1751241600000, 1767312000000, 1722384000000, 1760659200000, 1744156800000, 1769040000000, 1743984000000, 1765497600000, 1745193600000, 1739836800000, 1745193600000, 1762905600000, 1774396800000, 1730678400000, 1748822400000, 1770854400000, 1730851200000, 1748822400000, 1755820800000, 1751500800000, 1722816000000, 1743984000000, 1766448000000, 1757376000000, 1748390400000, 1712880000000, 1744329600000)
    var tl_start_price = array.from(21.2700, 31.7500, 32.6300, 17.5800, 20.7900, 31.8500, 27.5800, 46.6100, 19.0600, 40.0200, 445.9500, 474.6700, 20.4700, 17.2900, 217.2100, 259.8300, 288.5000, 101.9200, 110.9900, 109.9900, 104.2400, 64.6600, 86.9800, 150.6100, 130.9000, 102.3500, 26.4200)

    var tl_end_price   = array.from(43.6923, 53.3328, 64.0142, 18.4389, 29.3746, 46.6483, 34.0614, 49.0100, 36.7288, 50.4666, 413.9838, 718.7291, 37.7758, 36.7449, 289.2372, 289.4514, 394.4922, 86.8238, 132.9612, 130.5070, 144.8718, 78.5394, 115.2850, 177.6773, 179.5733, 239.9238, 33.6277)

    if barstate.islast and array.size(tl_tickers) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(tl_tickers) - 1
            if array.get(tl_tickers, i) == syminfo.ticker

                color tl_c  = array.get(tl_is_support, i) == 1 ? tl_support_color : tl_resistance_color
                float tl_p1 = array.get(tl_start_price, i)

                if not na(tl_p1) and not na(tl_p2)

// ─── Rise Curve ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_draw_rc() =>
    // ─── Rise Curve — Pattern Data ───────────────────────────────
    var rc_tickers  = array.from("CPAY", "ECO", "FIHL", "GEF", "GIC", "LNC", "NUE", "SHOO", "WEX", "AMP", "BLFS", "ING", "JLL", "PRU", "RJF", "SEIC", "HQY", "RTX", "WSBC")
    var rc_start_ts = array.from(1783296000000, 1783296000000, 1780358400000, 1783296000000, 1783296000000, 1783296000000, 1783296000000, 1783296000000, 1783296000000, 1780617600000, 1780617600000, 1780617600000, 1780617600000, 1780617600000, 1780617600000, 1780617600000, 1777939200000, 1777939200000, 1777939200000)
    var rc_end_ts   = array.from(1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1782950400000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000, 1785888000000)
    var rc_lb       = array.from(23, 23, 16, 23, 23, 23, 23, 23, 23, 42, 42, 42, 42, 42, 42, 42, 64, 64, 64)
    var rc_a        = array.from(0.00021557, 0.00006605, 0.00017368, 0.00066903, 0.00018177, 0.00010742, 0.00028668, 0.00009454, 0.00018410, 0.00007304, 0.00015878, 0.00000485, 0.00007124, 0.00002009, 0.00004343, 0.00011572, 0.00003609, 0.00004894, 0.00004656)
    var rc_b        = array.from(0.000304, 0.004574, 0.008149, -0.004470, 0.001825, 0.006240, 0.002825, 0.006615, 0.007796, 0.002410, -0.001120, 0.003681, 0.001955, 0.003443, 0.002443, -0.000407, 0.001303, 0.000662, 0.000857)
    var rc_c        = array.from(5.876474, 3.976874, 3.067588, 4.302307, 3.498929, 3.647797, 5.411289, 3.681603, 5.008433, 6.119550, 3.282789, 3.390136, 5.689379, 4.650335, 5.020256, 4.493344, 4.414373, 5.152540, 3.530177)
    var rc_log_rise = array.from(0.1110, 0.1326, 0.1613, 0.2255, 0.1281, 0.1893, 0.2009, 0.1913, 0.2606, 0.2216, 0.2210, 0.1591, 0.1999, 0.1749, 0.1732, 0.1779, 0.2253, 0.2359, 0.2388)
    var rc_periods  = array.from("1M", "1M", "1M", "1M", "1M", "1M", "1M", "1M", "1M", "2M", "2M", "2M", "2M", "2M", "2M", "2M", "3M", "3M", "3M")
    if barstate.islast and array.size(rc_tickers) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(rc_tickers) - 1
            if array.get(rc_tickers, i) == syminfo.ticker

                int   rc_t0    = array.get(rc_start_ts, i)
                int   rc_t1    = array.get(rc_end_ts, i)
                float rc_lb_f  = float(array.get(rc_lb, i)) - 1.0
                float rc_a_v   = array.get(rc_a, i)
                float rc_b_v   = array.get(rc_b, i)
                float rc_c_v   = array.get(rc_c, i)
                for k = 0 to 14
                    float frac0 = float(k)     / 15.0
                    float frac1 = float(k + 1) / 15.0
                    float t0    = frac0 * rc_lb_f
                    float t1    = frac1 * rc_lb_f
                    int   ts0   = int(rc_t0 + frac0 * (rc_t1 - rc_t0))
                    int   ts1   = int(rc_t0 + frac1 * (rc_t1 - rc_t0))
                    float y0    = math.exp(rc_a_v * t0 * t0 + rc_b_v * t0 + rc_c_v)
                    float y1    = math.exp(rc_a_v * t1 * t1 + rc_b_v * t1 + rc_c_v)
                    line.new(x1=ts0, y1=y0, x2=ts1, y2=y1, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=rc_color, width=rc_line_width)
                if rc_show_labels
                    float rc_end_price = math.exp(rc_a_v * rc_lb_f * rc_lb_f + rc_b_v * rc_lb_f + rc_c_v)
                    float rc_gain_pct  = (math.exp(array.get(rc_log_rise, i)) - 1.0) * 100.0
                    string rc_lbl_txt  = array.get(rc_periods, i) + "  +" + str.tostring(rc_gain_pct, "#.1") + "%"
                    label.new(x=rc_t1, y=rc_end_price, text=rc_lbl_txt, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(rc_color, 80), textcolor=rc_color, size=size.small)
